subject: Mid-window strategy pulse: priority splits and dependency nominations
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mid-window strategy pulse: priority splits and dependency nominations

Team —

Quick mid-window pulse and ask as we head into QBR week. I reviewed the OKR tracker and the top-line problem: two competing priorities (dedicated capacity throughput improvements vs. rollout of private deployment onboarding templates) are contending for infra and PM bandwidth. We need a short decision and clear dependency owners so we don’t drift into QBR with vague asks.

High-level status (by objective):
- O1 (Improve cost/perf for hosted inference): On track, but three infra tasks remain (kernel selector tuning, batcher hotpath, regression tests).
- O2 (Private deployments scale & docs): Behind by ~2 weeks; onboarding templates and the secure network checklist are still in draft.
- O3 (Developer experience / Console): On schedule but depends on O1's perf changes for accurate telemetry.

Requests:
1) Please nominate a single dependency owner for infra capacity & rollout gating by EOD Tue. This owner will coordinate with infra to reserve Dedicated slots and prioritize kernel tuning.
2) Vanessa — can you surface the top 3 customer-facing templates that must ship before Nov 10 so we can triage scope?
3) Markus — recommend which perf work can be deferred to next cycle vs. must-land pre-QBR.

I attached a trimmed spreadsheet with the prioritized asks and tentative owners. Aim: firm list of dependencies + owners by end of week so the QBR slide is actionable.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
VP Product Ops, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q4-prioritized-asks.xlsx
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Mid-window strategy pulse: priority splits and dependency nominations

On Mon, Oct 19, 2026 at 9:12 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick mid-window pulse and ask as we head into QBR week...

Thanks for the summary, Laura. My read: we can't fully defer kernel selector tuning — the perf delta will materially change the Console telemetry and customer-facing latency numbers. However, one lower-risk item (multi-arch quant profile validation) can move to post-QBR.

Proposal:
- Must-land pre-QBR: kernel selector tuning (owner: Markus), batcher hotpath optimization (owner: Infra Eng lead).
- Deferable: quant validation sweep for legacy Llama variants (move to Nov cycle).

I can be the dependency owner for the perf gating and will coordinate with Infra to reserve Dedicated slots for a 48-hour tuning window the week of Oct 26.

Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Serving Runtime
markus_klein@redwood.com

Attached is a short list of the customer templates we consider critical for private onboarding. TL;DR the top three that impact sales momentum:
- Secure VPC checklist (must ship)
- Onboarding runbook for customer-managed KMS (must ship)
- Data retention & audit-log mapping doc (nice-to-have pre-QBR, but not blocking)

Nominations:
- Secure VPC checklist: owner = Vanessa Ortiz (partner with Solutions Eng: Rishi)
- KMS runbook: owner = Naomi Feldman (legal & security touchpoint)
- Data retention mapping: owner = Tessa Morgan (docs + compliance)

Notes: Novum Health (John Sawyer) flagged the VPC checklist as gating their pilot on Nov 8. I pinged John and copied him below to confirm timeline. I also uploaded the candidate templates to the Drive link in the sheet.

Vanessa

Thanks everyone — concise recap and owners below (for QBR slide):

Priority decisions (finalized):
- Perf gating (kernel selector + batcher hotpath): owner = Markus Klein. Infra reservation: Oct 26–28, 48h tuning window.
- Private onboarding templates: owners = Vanessa (VPC checklist), Naomi (KMS runbook), Tessa (data retention mapping).

Deliverables & deadlines:
- Markus: tuning plan + risk notes by Oct 24 — acknowledged and slot reserved.
- Naomi: KMS runbook draft by Oct 27 EOD (will include rotation cadence & SOC2 evidence checklist).
- Vanessa: VPC checklist draft with subnet/CIDR example by Nov 1.
- Tessa: data retention mapping doc by Nov 1 (optional pre-QBR).

I’ll slot these items into the QBR deck and share a preview by EOD Wed. If any of the owners see a conflict with the dates above, reply-all with the blocker and proposed mitigation.

Laura
